info.name: Apache OpenMeetings REST CalendarService RoomService API

description.content: The OpenMeetings REST API provides endpoints for managing rooms, users, recordings, calendars, file uploads, whiteboards, and groups. It supports SOAP API for legacy integrations and plugin APIs for LMS integration.
